:::{#def-specificity}
#### Specificity

The **specificity** of a diagnostic test is the probability
that the test is [negative](#def-negative-classification) ($\negclass$),
given that the person tested does not have the disease ($\neg D$):

$$\text{specificity} \eqdef \Pr(\negclass \mid \neg D)$$ {#eq-specificity}

Source: @wikipedia_sensitivity_and_specificity.
:::
